verses.text: [“]At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up. There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time. But at that time your people— everyone whose name is found written in the book— will be delivered.

xrefs.text: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unseen from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
How awful that day will be! None will be like it! It is the time of Jacob’s distress, but he will be saved out of it.
For those will be days of tribulation unseen from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, “It is done!
How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.

verses.text: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt.

xrefs.text: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.
Therefore prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘O My people, I will open your graves and bring you up from them, and I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And books were opened, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.

verses.text: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.

xrefs.text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.
The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
Those with insight will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by sword or flame, or be captured or plundered.
Some of the wise will fall so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.

verses.text: But you, Daniel, shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many will roam to and fro, and knowledge will increase.”

xrefs.text: “Go on your way, Daniel,” he replied, “for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
The vision of the evenings and the mornings that has been spoken is true. Now you must seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future.”
As he came near to where I stood, I was terrified and fell facedown. “Son of man,” he said to me, “understand that the vision concerns the time of the end.”
When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.

verses.text: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing there, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.

xrefs.text: And suddenly one with the likeness of a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and said to the one standing before me, “My lord, because of the vision, I am overcome with anguish, and I have no strength.
On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,
Suddenly, a hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees.

verses.text: One of them said to the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long until the fulfillment of these wonders?”

xrefs.text: Then the angel of the LORD said, “How long, O LORD of Hosts, will You withhold mercy from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been angry these seventy years?”

And I saw six men coming from the direction of the Upper Gate, which faces north, each with a weapon of slaughter in his hand. With them was another man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. And they came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, “How long until the fulfillment of the vision of the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled?”
And I heard the voice of a man calling from between the banks of the Ulai: “Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.”
I lifted up my eyes, and behold, there was a certain man dressed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.

verses.text: And the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever, saying, “It will be for a time, and times, and half a time. When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered, all these things will be completed.”

xrefs.text: He will speak out against the Most High and oppress the saints of the Most High, intending to change the appointed times and laws; and the saints will be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time.
But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
His power will be great, but it will not be his own. He will cause terrible destruction and succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy the mighty men along with the holy people.
Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.
The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.

verses.text: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”

xrefs.text: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.

At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
One of them said to the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long until the fulfillment of these wonders?”
Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision concerns those days.”

Bind up the testimony and seal the law among my disciples.
And the entire vision will be to you like the words sealed in a scroll. If it is handed to someone to read, he will say, “I cannot, because it is sealed.”
When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.

verses.text: Many will be purified, made spotless, and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the wise will understand.

xrefs.text: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.
Some of the wise will fall so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.
Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.

Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.

verses.text: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up, there will be 1,290 days.

xrefs.text: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress. They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation.
So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ spoken of by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

And he will confirm a covenant with many for one week, but in the middle of the week he will put an end to sacrifice and offering. And on the wing of the temple will come the abomination that causes desolation, until the decreed destruction is poured out upon him.

verses.text: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.

xrefs.text: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
He said to me, “It will take 2300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be properly restored.”
For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

verses.text: But as for you, go on your way until the end. You will rest, and then you will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.”

xrefs.text: And I heard a voice from heaven telling me to write, “Blessed are the dead— those who die in the Lord from this moment on. “Yes, says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

“This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘If you walk in My ways and keep My instructions, then you will govern My house and will also have charge of My courts; and I will give you a place among these who are standing here.
Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.
